instruction: Read review_cases.json. Independently review each candidate against the supplied contract. Write review.json with exactly {"schema_version":1,"cases":[...]} where each case entry has exactly: id, verdict (PASS|FAIL|UNKNOWN), and defect_paths (array of exact JSON Pointer strings). PASS requires no contract defect; FAIL requires every concrete defect path you can establish from the supplied candidate; UNKNOWN is only for insufficient evidence. Do not rewrite candidates. Do not invent semantic defects outside the supplied contract.
